title: The 144,000 on Mount Zion
description: John sees the Lamb standing on Mount Zion with 144,000 who have the name of the Lamb and the Father written on their foreheads. He hears a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and thunder, and the 144,000 sing a new song before the throne that no one else can learn. They are described as virgins who follow the Lamb wherever he goes, bought from the earth as firstfruits for God and the Lamb, with no lie in their mouths and without blemish.
